title: How many rak‘ahs? The five prayers in full
intro: Sunnah, fard and witr – 40 rak‘ahs every day.

learn.html: Every prayer has fard rak‘ahs (a duty) and most have sunnah rak‘ahs (what the Prophet (SAW) prayed). Isha also has witr.

learn.title: 🔢 40 rak‘ahs
learn.html: 4 + 10 + 8 + 5 + 13 = 40 rak‘ahs every day. Of them 17 are fard: 2 + 4 + 4 + 3 + 4.

learn.title: 🤲 Witr and the Qunut
learn.html: In the 3rd rak‘ah of witr we recite the Qunut dua. Learn it: The Qunut Dua.

learn.title: ⭐ Remember
learn.html: In a fard of 3 or 4 rak‘ahs, after the first two rak‘ahs we sit for At-Tahiyyat, then stand up; in its 3rd and 4th rak‘ahs we recite only Al-Fatiha.
